title: Final Answer for (a)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state that the entropy stays the same when the rubber band is stretched isothermally.

title: Final Answer for (b)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state that the internal energy increases when the rubber band is stretched adiabatically.

title: Work Done Expression
description: Important Criteria: The student should include the correct expression for work done on the rubber band, dW = kxdx.

title: Maxwell Relation Application
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate understanding of the Maxwell relation and its application to the problem.

title: Internal Energy Equation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly reference the equation dU = TdS + kxdx in the context of adiabatic stretching.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid sign mistakes in the expressions for work or energy changes.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Clarification of Terms
description: Optional Criteria: The student may provide definitions or clarifications for terms like entropy and internal energy.
